adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the server computes `uniqueGuests` by filtering out emails already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted ones, but then calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` with the raw input `guests` (not `uniqueGuests`). In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (email-manager.ts), the attendee email template is chosen based on `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)`. So if a caller resubmits an email that is already an attendee, it will still be present in `guests`, causing that existing attendee to match `includes` and receive the "scheduled" email (`AttendeeScheduledEmail`) even though they weren't newly added. This behavior is directly implied by the diff.
